summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of Lewi House (kostan PWA). Backend: 17 pytest tests across health, rooms CRUD, tenants CRUD + room auto-assign/reassign/free, bills CRUD + filters + mark-paid + total recompute, complaints CRUD + resolved_at, dashboard summary and monthly report — 16/17 passed. Frontend: all 5 tabs verified on 390x844 mobile viewport (Dashboard metrics/chart/alert, Rooms filters+create/edit/delete, Tenants create with room auto-fill rent + edit + delete, Bills filters + mark paid + create with rent auto-fill, Complaints create/resolve/delete). All flows worked, zero console errors. DB re-seeded to clean demo state after testing.

minor.issue: Malformed (non-ObjectId) path id raises bson.errors.InvalidId -> HTTP 500 Internal Server Error instead of 400/404. Repro: GET /api/rooms/not-an-objectid
Always returns {ok:true} even when the id does not exist (no 404); deleted_count not checked

$set is applied before existence check, and 404 is only raised after the update attempt; also PUT with a full RoomCreate body silently resets status/tenant_id consistency (deleting an occupied room leaves the tenant pointing at a non-existent room_id — no referential cleanup)
Destructive dev endpoint is publicly exposed with no guard/auth — wipes all collections
No enum/Literal validation on status fields (room.status, bill.status, complaint.status, priority) — arbitrary strings accepted; price/rent negatives accepted (no ge=0)

issues: 'PENDAPATAN BULAN INI' value (Rp 0) is visually clipped/overlapped by the Okupansi/Belum Bayar cards that float over the hero image — the big amount is cut in half on 390x844 viewport
Success toast renders over the page title (e.g. covers 'Penghuni'/'Keluhan'/'Tagihan' headers) instead of below/above the safe area
Complaint created without tenant/room shows placeholder meta '- · - · 24 Agu 2026'; should hide empty segments
Seed avatar for male tenant 'Arya Wibowo' is a female photo (avatar/name mismatch in seed data)
'Terlambat' (overdue) filter chip exists but backend/seed never produces overdue bills — always empty; no auto-overdue logic based on due_date

action_items: Add a shared ObjectId parse helper (return 400/404 instead of 500) for all /{id} endpoints
Return 404 on DELETE when the document does not exist (check deleted_count)
Fix dashboard hero overlap so 'Pendapatan Bulan Ini' amount is not clipped by the floating metric cards
Reposition toasts so they don't cover page headers
Optional: guard POST /api/seed, add Literal/ge=0 validation on models, implement overdue derivation for the 'Terlambat' filter
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: ObjectId(room_id) is called on raw path params in 10+ places without try/except -> guaranteed 500 on malformed ids; wrap in a dependency e.g. def oid(v)->ObjectId raising HTTPException(400)
Deleting a room does not clear tenant.room_id / related bills, leaving orphaned references
PUT endpoints update first and check existence afterwards, so a 404 path still performs a no-op write; check existence first
Bill.total is recomputed correctly server-side (good), but status transitions are unvalidated (any string accepted)
seed_data_creation: Used POST /api/seed (6 rooms, 3 tenants, 9 bills, 2 complaints). All TEST_ prefixed artifacts (room, tenant, bill, complaint) were deleted, and DB was re-seeded at the end so state is clean demo data.
test_credentials: N/A - app has no auth; /app/memory/test_credentials.md does not exist (not required)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (session-scoped autouse fixture re-seeds DB, so running it wipes data). Only known failure: test_get_room_invalid_id (500 on malformed ObjectId). All frontend data-testids listed in the request exist and work, plus input-room-price, input-tenant-rent, input-bill-rent, input-bill-electricity, input-complaint-status/description, delete-room-{id}, delete-tenant-{id}, delete-complaint-{id}, room-card-{id}, tenant-card-{id}, bill-card-{id}, complaint-card-{id}.
rca_of_the_issue: 500 on invalid id: bson.ObjectId(str) raises InvalidId for non-24-hex strings; server.py line 156 (and all other /{id} handlers) constructs ObjectId directly from the path param with no validation, so the exception propagates as an unhandled 500 (confirmed in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log).
